title: Gmail
description: Exposes Gmail operations as agent tools.
Read, search, label, draft, send, and organize mail, with permanent delete gated.
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

gmail.access.title: Access level
gmail.access.description: Gmail scopes to request. readonly: read only. modify: read + label/organize. send: modify + send mail. full: complete mailbox access, required for permanent delete.

gmail.allowHardDelete.title: Allow permanent delete
gmail.allowHardDelete.description: When enabled (and access is set to Full), message_delete and messages_batchDelete can permanently delete mail, bypassing Trash. Irreversible. Off by default.
